definitions.gloss: string music; music for stringed instruments
definitions.explanation: Music played on bowed stringed instruments such as the violin, viola, and cello. Used mainly in classical music, in the names of ensembles and works.

examples.japanese: {弦楽|げんがく}{四重奏|しじゅうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧。
examples.english: To listen to a string quartet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{弦楽|げんがく}⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦チェロ→チェロ：08115_chero⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}いていた→弾く：02444_hiku⟧。
examples.english: At university I played the cello in the string orchestra club.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{弦楽|げんがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生演奏|なまえんそう}→生演奏：16478_namaensou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}げた→盛り上げる：07895_moriageru⟧。
examples.english: At the wedding, live string music set the mood in the hall.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弦楽|げんがく}{四重奏|しじゅうそう}: string quartet
- {弦楽|げんがく}⟦{合奏|がっそう}→合奏：16325_gassou⟧: string ensemble
- ⟦{弦楽器|げんがっき}→弦楽器：07534_gengakki⟧: stringed instrument
- {弦楽|げんがく}⟦オーケストラ→オーケストラ：04466_ookesutora⟧: string orchestra

WATCH OUT:
Homophone of ⟦{減額|げんがく}→減額：28225_gengaku⟧ (reduction in an amount of money). {管楽|かんがく} is the matching word for wind music (⟦{管楽器|かんがっき}→管楽器：07533_kangakki⟧, wind instrument).
